title: CoLearn pipelines
about: What the dashboard on GitHub Pages watches. Each workflow shows its latest run per branch; a workflow may name its own branches, or "any" for a manual one that runs from wherever it was started. staleAfterHours turns a pass amber once it is older than that, so a nightly or weekly job that stopped running shows up.
